description: An aborted flow attempt can leave an untracked plans/I-<intent id>-<slug>/ directory in the flow worktree. validate_mounted_workspace in entrypoint/execution_workspace.py runs 'git status --porcelain' over the whole mounted workspace except the engine-owned ledger paths, so that leftover directory makes the workspace count as uncommitted and the next planner (or intent creator) run for the same intent refuses to start with 'mounted workspace ... has uncommitted changes'. A later attempt therefore fails for a reason it did not cause.
goal: validate_mounted_workspace no longer counts untracked files under the engine-owned plan directory (plans/I-*/) as uncommitted changes, so a leftover plan directory from an aborted attempt does not block planning; every other uncommitted change (tracked edits anywhere, untracked files outside plans/I-*/) is still refused with the same message. The engine-owned exclusion stays next to the existing engine-owned ledger and notes exclusions and is reused by the resume check that already consumes them. The module line budgets are frozen: do not edit holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json or any budget-check script, and keep every touched module within its current budget.
rationale: The cleanliness check exists to protect foreign uncommitted work on the host; plan artefacts the engine itself wrote in an earlier attempt are not foreign, and refusing them makes a retry fail for a reason it did not cause.
acceptance_criteria: A mounted workspace whose only uncommitted change is an untracked file under plans/I-<id>-<slug>/ passes validate_mounted_workspace and returns the plan branch tip.

A mounted workspace with an untracked file outside plans/I-*/, or a tracked file modified anywhere (including a tracked file under plans/), is still refused with the existing 'has uncommitted changes' message.

The existing exclusions for the engine-owned ledger paths, pending ledger directory and execution notes are unchanged, and the public names of execution_workspace.py are unchanged; no other source file changes.

A new test file apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_execution_workspace_untracked_plans.py uses a real temporary git repository and covers the untracked plan directory accepted, an untracked foreign file refused, and a modified tracked file refused; it fails on the old code and passes on the new.
The module budgets file and every budget-check script are untouched and every touched module stays within its current line budget.
uv run pytest passes for the new test file and the existing tests that cover execution_workspace (test_host_worktree_sandbox.py, test_resume_tip.py).
